title: A group's work orders made with their lead follow List's default order
refs: SV-10052 (S9-R14 created with lead keeps initial sort / S2-R6 / S9-R3 - spec v64)
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View, Work orders > Create & Edit and Schedule access, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
  • User {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Sort Viewer) is a staff member with the Admin role at {Location-A}, can sign in, and has never changed or saved a sort in List.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example Owen Created QA1019) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User, so they have a row on the Schedule page. {Technician-A} leads no work order.
  • Customers {Customer-A} (for example "Alpha Freight QA1019"), {Customer-B} (for example "Mid Trucking QA1019") and {Customer-C} (for example "Zeta Hauling QA1019") start with different first letters, end with the same words (for example QA1019) and each has an asset.
  • Nobody has reordered {Technician-A}'s work orders at {Location-A}.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is ticked in Status, Asset on Site shows no choice, Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Click Schedule in the top menu and find {Technician-A}'s row.
  2. Click an empty cell in {Technician-A}'s row. A small menu opens with Assign Work Order, Create Event and New Work Order. Click New Work Order.
  3. In the New Work Order dialog choose {Customer-C} in Customer, choose its asset in Asset and click Save. Write down the new work order's number ({Work-order-1}).
  4. Repeat steps 2 and 3 for {Customer-A} ({Work-order-2}), then for {Customer-B} ({Work-order-3}), then for {Customer-B} again ({Work-order-4}). Use an empty cell each time. The four work orders are now made in this order: {Customer-C}, {Customer-A}, {Customer-B}, {Customer-B}.
  5. Sign in as {User-B}. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click List in the display switcher.
  6. Type the shared end of the three customer names (for example QA1019) in Search.
  7. Write down the order of the four work orders in List, and the name in their Lead Technician column.
  8. Click Tech View in the display switcher and write down the order of the rows in {Technician-A}'s group.
  9. Click Board View in the display switcher and write down the order of the cards in {Technician-A}'s column.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: all four work orders show {Technician-A} as Lead Technician, because each was made with its lead. List shows them in its usual default order: by customer name from A to Z, and the two {Customer-B} work orders newest first: {Work-order-2}, {Work-order-4}, {Work-order-3}, {Work-order-1}.
  • Step 8: Tech View's rows in {Technician-A}'s group are in that same order: {Work-order-2}, {Work-order-4}, {Work-order-3}, {Work-order-1}. They are NOT in the order they were made, and they did NOT go to the bottom one after another (S9-R14).
  • Step 9: Board View's cards in {Technician-A}'s column are in the same order as Tech View's rows.

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View) and SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder). PRD “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, Confluence 845185030, version 64, S9-R14, S2-R6 and S9-R3, read 19 Oct 2026.
  • Chris Ward on the PRD (v53), quoted on SV-11312 (comment 78792, 15 Oct 2026): “A work order created with its lead keeps the initial sort.”
  • Companion case C96929 covers the other half of the same rule: a work order that gets its lead after it was made goes to the bottom.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R14: “… Going to the bottom applies only to work moved onto a technician. A work order created or split off with a lead keeps the initial sort (S9-R3).”
  • S2-R6: “Before a manual order is saved, use the List’s default work order sort, ties included, exactly as the List sorts today: work orders for the same customer go by start date, newest first. The List itself does not change.”

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-10043 and the Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options specification version 64 (S9-R14, S2-R6, S9-R3). Last checked against build v26.40.19-e435950 (staging) on 10/19/2026.
